ideas.pitch: A multi-agent market research and product validation engine designed specifically to generate investor-ready business plans for student entrepreneurs.
ideas.title: Marketmind Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the judging criteria of market validation, business model feasibility, and go-to-market planning required by the Business Plan Competition format.

ideas.pitch: An automated financial projections and cash-flow scenario generator tailored for early-stage startup pitch decks.
ideas.title: FinPlan AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact financial requirements and projections section of the required 5-minute pitch structure, which most student teams struggle to calculate accurately.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local B2B marketplace aggregator connecting college-town micro-merchants with logistics providers.
ideas.title: SupplySync Go
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents a highly tangible, localized go-to-market plan that judges can immediately understand and verify during the 3-minute Q&A session.

ideas.pitch: A direct-to-retail supply chain optimization and pricing strategy platform for regional agricultural produce.
ideas.title: AgriRoute B2B
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a massive domestic market opportunity in India, giving the business plan immediate real-world scalability and high commercial viability in front of a jury.

ideas.pitch: A B2B SaaS subscription and inventory tracking platform designed for independent local pharmacies in Tier-2 Indian cities.
ideas.title: MedLogix Business
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a clear B2B recurring revenue model with low customer acquisition cost, hitting every metric a business plan jury looks for.
